name: Aloo Palak
description: Pakistani aloo palak with tender potatoes and spinach cooked in a garlic, cumin and tomato masala until the greens coat the potatoes without excess water.
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach, washed thoroughly and chopped
3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into even cubes
method: Heat the oil in a wide pan, add the cumin seeds and sliced garlic, then add the onion and cook until softened and lightly golden.
Add the tomatoes, green chillies, coriander powder, red chilli, turmeric and salt and cook until the tomatoes soften and the masala becomes cohesive.
Add the potato cubes and a small splash of water, cover and cook gently until the potatoes are almost tender, stirring occasionally so the masala does not catch.
Add the chopped spinach in batches if necessary; it will wilt rapidly and release its own moisture, so avoid adding extra water unless the pan genuinely needs it.
Cook uncovered until the potatoes are fully tender and excess spinach liquid has evaporated, stirring gently enough to keep the potato pieces intact.
Taste for seasoning and serve hot with roti or paratha.
